data.title: 阿尔托莉雅 · 午后洗衣房的整齐衣角
data.description: 午后的自助洗衣房里，阿尔托莉雅穿深蓝开衫、白衬衫和裙装，坐在折衣台旁的矮凳上。膝前的竹篮盛着刚洗好的衣物，她双手捏住一条白毛巾的两角，在台面上把毛巾对折，碧绿眼睛认真检查边缘是否齐整。背后的滚筒洗衣机排成一列，窗外日光映亮她的金色盘发与蓝丝带，神情专注而放松。
data.location: 午后自助洗衣房折衣台旁
data.action: 坐在矮凳上，双手捏住白毛巾两角，在台面上对折并对齐边缘。
data.camera: medium shot, eye level, seated environmental portrait
data.promptProse: Artoria Pendragon aligns the white towel's corners with both hands at the laundromat folding counter, seated on a low stool beside a wicker basket. Her dark-blue cardigan, white shirt and skirt accompany focused green eyes beneath the blonde braided bun and blue ribbon. Closed washing machines recede behind the eye-level medium view. Diffuse afternoon window light reveals the towel's overlapping layers, with small hand shadows and a darker basket interior.
